caption_L1: Here a is a area diagram labeled Burundi : Infant mortality rate from 2009 to 2019 (in deaths per 1,000 live births). The y-axis shows Deaths per 1,000 live births while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: The mortality rate has been decreasing over the period. The rate of decrease has been fairly consistent, but the rate of improvement has declined slightly since around 2015. In 2009, the mortality rate was around 62 per 1000 live births and this had dropped to just over 40 in the ten-year period.
